segment.source: ::The man silences you with a swift gesture of his hand, for his prey is about to bite. The float disappears under the surface, and the rod bends downward. The fisherman grasps it tightly, yanking the rod as if he was expecting to pull a sunken ferry out of the depths. Soon enough, a small light-bluish eel flies through the air and ends its journey in the man's raw-boned hand.::<end>

segment.target: Hey! *Mr. Ford*. Your ears are workin' worse than mine, $(#son/woman).<end>

segment.source: I heard you right, but I'm sticking with Geezer Ford. Suits you better.<end>
segment.target: I heard you right, but I'm sticking with Geezer Ford. Suits you better.<end>

segment.source: Look here, $(#you little hopper son of a rail/you brainless baggage). I ain't gonna stand here and listen to you disrespectin' me, you dig? Now get lost!<end>
segment.target: Look here, $(#you little hopper son of a rail/you brainless baggage). I ain't gonna stand here and listen to you disrespectin' me, you dig? Now get lost!<end>

segment.source: Someone's sensitive. Bye, old man.<end>
segment.target: Someone's sensitive. Bye, old man.<end>

segment.source: Stupid old jerk.<end>
segment.target: Stupid old jerk.<end>

segment.source: ::Nod and leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Nod and leave.::<end>

segment.source: Let's talk then.<end>
segment.target: Let's talk then.<end>

segment.source: Yeah.<end>
segment.target: Yeah.<end>

segment.source: How about you tell me something about yourself?<end>
segment.target: How about you tell me something about yourself?<end>

segment.source: About Junkyard.<end>
segment.target: About Junkyard.<end>

segment.source: About fishing.<end>
segment.target: About fishing.<end>

segment.source: I said: Nice catch.<end>
segment.target: I said: Nice catch.<end>

segment.source: Wha'? That thing? ::He laughs.:: That ain't good enough to feed a cat, $(#son/woman). If you're tryin' to act nice, then don't, and if you're tryin' to make fun of me then go stick your head in a siphoner's rear, ya dig?<end>
segment.target: Wha'? That thing? ::He laughs.:: That ain't good enough to feed a cat, $(#son/woman). If you're tryin' to act nice, then don't, and if you're tryin' to make fun of me then go stick your head in a siphoner's rear, ya dig?<end>

segment.source: I didn't mean it in any bad way. Anyway, could I ask you a couple of questions?<end>
segment.target: I didn't mean it in any bad way. Anyway, could I ask you a couple of questions?<end>

segment.source: Actually, I *was* trying to mock you. That was the lamest catch I've ever seen.<end>
segment.target: Actually, I *was* trying to mock you. That was the lamest catch I've ever seen.<end>

segment.source: Get outta here, you hopper son of a rail! I ain't gonna listen to you speaking outta your ass, you dig? Get lost!<end>
segment.target: Get outta here, you hopper son of a rail! I ain't gonna listen to you speaking outta your ass, you dig? Get lost!<end>

segment.source: I said: Why did you release it back to the water?<end>
segment.target: I said: Why did you release it back to the water?<end>

segment.source: Wha'? The eel? I ain't gonna eat a tiny eel. It's too small to feed a cat. No, you let 'em live and grow, and then you catch them and eat them. Or sell 'em, whatever.<end>
segment.target: Wha'? The eel? I ain't gonna eat a tiny eel. It's too small to feed a cat. No, you let 'em live and grow, and then you catch them and eat them. Or sell 'em, whatever.<end>

segment.source: I see. Can I ask you a couple of questions?<end>
segment.target: I see. Can I ask you a couple of questions?<end>

segment.source: ::Speak to yourself.:: Yeah, you didn't catch anything good today.<end>
segment.target: ::Speak to yourself.:: Yeah, you didn't catch anything good today.<end>

segment.source: You stop mumbling, $(#son/woman), and speak up.<end>
segment.target: You stop mumbling, $(#son/woman), and speak up.<end>

segment.source: Nice catch.<end>
segment.target: Nice catch.<end>

segment.source: Why'd you let it back into the water?<end>
segment.target: Why'd you let it back into the water?<end>

segment.source: Greetings, old man.<end>
segment.target: Greetings, old man.<end>

segment.source: Fishing, are we?<end>
segment.target: Fishing, are we?<end>

segment.source: Can I ask you a few questions?<end>
segment.target: Can I ask you a few questions?<end>

segment.source: ::Leave him alone.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave him alone.::<end>

segment.source: You again.<end>
segment.target: You again.<end>
